description: soft, undulating swirls that echo the wave‑shaped roofs: base colour #BCE7A5, the shapes in slightly lighter and darker shades of the base colour. It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which everything in the district shares: Bright pastel blues and sandy beiges dominate, with curved, wave‑shaped houses, light timber frames, whitewashed walls, and a breezy, relaxed seaside mood.
